records.response: Hold supported stock; wait for trusted safe release or qualified service recovery.
Stop; preserve evidence; quarantine mismatch and require new allocation.
Invalidate token and both affected captures; retain readings; reconfigure only after supported release.

records.fault: One image missing, blurred or occluded
records.response: Preserve partial pair; reacquire both views under a valid token; link new acquisition to rejected attempt.
Reject pair and recalibrate; no backfilled calibration.
Retain valid observations and uncertainty; flag measurement limitation; do not force the expected curve.

records.fault: Torn crease, changed rest state or unrecovered specimen
records.response: Unload safely and quarantine; a replacement is a new specimen/series.
Do not start; hold only the affected qualitative branch.
Block model-based acceptance; continue legitimate image custody if metrology requirements are met.
Leave specimen supported and protected; report exact unresolved state.

release_selection.unmounted_unloaded: No fictitious mount release; retain custody and inspect

retry: New attempt, token and capture IDs; link prior failure, preserve rejected raw records. Replacement specimen starts a new series.
closeout: Held state is a legitimate terminal accounting disposition but never physical completion. Unknown attachment or load means supported hold, no storage transfer.
